data.desc: Massimo Group (NASDAQ: MAMO) is a manufacturer and distributor of powersports and recreational vehicles, including UTVs, ATVs, golf carts, go-karts and other utility and recreational products. Headquartered in Garland, Texas, the Company operates a large manufacturing and assembly facility supporting its expanding product portfolio and distribution network throughout the United States. Massimo products are sold through a nationwide network of dealers, distributors, major retailers and direct-to-consumer channels.
